notes.title: Steam Deck Verfied and 50% off
notes.content:
Dotson on Deck
Detective Dotson plays has received Steam Deck Verified status from Steam!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273861/6111e329ec441dfb9fd6813857ce96ff42a41679.png"]

The game looks and plays really well on the deck with larger text adjusted for the device.

Controller support is improved and the controller now works in the phone booth.

We've also added Korean and Russian language support.

Additionally there are performance fixes in the game.


An exciting summer
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273861/72da169315152a0846d9e93eb91cad15ec727668.png"]

We've got a summer filled with events and a 50% sale to celebrate

We are part of Debut Festival from August 7

We will be celebrating the Indian Independence Day on August 15
Amma is coming
Don't get too comfortable in summer, because Amma is coming!

Our chapter 2 free update is in the works and we are busy adding twists and turns you won't see coming.

What's more Detective Dotson will be at Gamescom and Tokyo Games Show

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273861/98470907cbd4760398ae13e24aad5afa0282c60e.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273861/9e88effb51727d411331c2ccb04dfc22d1bb4a26.png"]

notes.title: May 7 update (4 languages, character bios and fixes)
notes.content:
We've added 4 new languages!
Traditional Chinese
German
Spanish
French

Added cute character intros in the main menu. Collect them all!
There's one more secret one that I can't put in this picture :)
https://i.postimg.cc/nzCcqYKm/dc-steam.png

Of course Parth had to blink while this picture was taken 🤦‍♀️

A bunch of fixes. Thank you all for reporting them!

We are now featuring full controller and Steam Deck support (will do a separate post on that)
